chunks: He said: "O my people, I am not a fool, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds."
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say to refute his people's claim that he was foolish?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Al-A'raf, the Prophet Hud addresses his tribe of 'Ad, refuting their claim that his wisdom was mere 'safaah' (folly or superficiality) by affirming his status as a divinely appointed messenger. This assertion underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the clarity of prophetic authority and the distinction between true divine guidance and human misperception, linking back to the narrative of the Bani Israel's similar accusations in the same Surah.
